Every value here is copied from a real continuous-integration run at the revision below.
Nothing in this file is measured locally. Where a lane has only local evidence, it is
recorded as BLOCKED with its reason, never as PASSED, because NOTHING LOCAL MAY BIND TO
This manifest is EXPECTED to verify non-zero. Most lanes are BLOCKED and each says why.
A non-zero verdict carrying stated reasons is the honest outcome at this revision; a pass
would require a release claim this revision's evidence does not support.
Offline with: the same command plus --offline (degrades only the attestation step).

revision.runIdNote: Two workflows produce evidence at this revision. `runId` names desktop.yml's run for schema compatibility; `runIds` names both, and every lane entry's evidence file records which job it came from.

artifacts.name: desktop-macos-app
artifacts.digestSha256Note: digestSha256 is the digest verify-release.mjs recomputes from the bytes at artifactPath, which are the package-manifest.json that CI job desktop-package emitted and uploaded, committed here verbatim. The application's own digest is applicationDigestSha256 below. The 129 MB application bytes are NOT committed to this repository; the committed bytes are the CI-produced record OF those bytes.

signing.statement: THESE CI-BUILT BYTES ARE UNSIGNED AND UNNOTARIZED. The Developer ID .p12 has not been exported to repository secrets, so the desktop-package job took its documented unsigned path and the package manifest records it as such (codeSigning.developerIdSigned=false, notarization.status=not-attempted). A signed, notarized and stapled build HAS been produced locally and verified end-to-end (spctl --assess: accepted, source=Notarized Developer ID), but that is a LOCAL attestation over LOCAL bytes at a different revision; under the anti-loophole rule it may not be attached to this artefact.

artifacts.note: A fifth artefact entry beyond D-12's four named ones, added deliberately. The governance lanes and the Phase 2 lanes run against SOURCE, not against a built artefact. Binding them to the packaged application's digest -- which the four-artefact schema would otherwise force -- would claim they tested bytes they never opened. The four artefacts D-12 names are all still present above; this entry exists so that a source-only lane's binding is TRUE rather than merely well-formed.

lanes.reason: Physical blocker. Row A14 changes the system appearance WHILE the app is running and asserts the window re-themes without a relaunch. That requires a logged-in Aqua session whose appearance daemon posts AppleInterfaceThemeChangedNotification; a hosted GitHub runner has none. Observed at this revision: `ROW id=A14 status=FAIL cases=4` on macos-15 with `background stayed {"b":0,"g":0,"r":0}` (run 34668212473). The identical row reports `status=PASS cases=4` on a real logged-in session. That local pass is NOT recorded as a passing status here: it binds to locally built bytes, and nothing local may bind to locally built bytes. See .planning/WINDOWS.md.

lanes.note: cases=1: the TccProbe ran on macos-15 and published its answer as the hosted-runner-tcc-report artefact. The answer at this revision is accessibility_trusted=true, screen_recording_preflight=true, universal_access_write={persisted:true, read_back_matched_token:true, synchronize_returned_true:true}. NOTE: accessibility_trusted=true is in TENSION with the macos-integration-full-grant lane's recorded physical blocker, which states a hosted runner cannot be given a non-interactive Accessibility grant. This lane exists precisely to publish what the runner actually grants rather than what the contract predicts, so the tension is recorded rather than reconciled by assertion. See .planning/WINDOWS.md.

Unwired, by a deliberate open decision recorded as .planning/WINDOWS.md row 82: a notarized Developer ID build is not byte-reproducible by construction, because @electron/osx-sign embeds a fresh RFC 3161 secure timestamp -- required for notarization -- into every signature blob. 16 of 618 entries differ and they are exactly the signature-bearing ones. The lane may not report PASSED while unwired. TO CLOSE: pick option (a) or (b) in row 82. Owner: BACKLOG.
